description: Notification confirming a Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies (CAS) reference has been issued to an international student applicant for a UK Student Route visa application.
subject: Your CAS has been issued — $cas_number
body:
Dear $first_name,

We have issued your Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies (CAS). You will need this reference when you submit your Student Route visa application to UKVI.

CAS details:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
CAS reference:    $cas_number
Student ID:       $student_id
Programme:        $programme
Course start:     $course_start_date
Course end:       $course_end_date
Tuition fee:      £$tuition_fee_gbp
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

What to do next:
• Apply for your Student Route visa at gov.uk/student-visa, quoting the CAS reference above.
• Pay the Immigration Health Surcharge as part of the application.
• Make sure your passport has at least 6 months of validity remaining at your travel date.
• If your programme requires ATAS clearance you must obtain it before travel — we will let you know separately if that applies to you.

If any of the details above are incorrect, please contact the International Office immediately so we can withdraw and re-issue the CAS.

Kind regards,
University International Office

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
